name: River Stablecoin
oneLiner: satUSD is River's omni-CDP stablecoin overcollateralized by BTC, ETH, BNB, and LSTs; collateral stays source-chain and satUSD is minted via LayerZero OFT.
collateral: BTC, ETH, BNB, and liquid staking tokens; no centralized stablecoin collateral accepted
pegMechanism: Omni-CDP overcollateralized by BTC, ETH, BNB, or LSTs; collateral stays on its source chain and satUSD is minted natively on the destination chain via LayerZero OFT messaging; peg maintained through stability pools, on-chain liquidations, and $1-of-collateral redemption arbitrage

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: satUSD resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: satUSD (River, formerly Satoshi Protocol) is a Liquity-v1-derived omni-CDP: users lock BTC/ETH/BNB/LSTs on a source chain and LayerZero OFT messaging authorizes a native satUSD mint on the destination chain, with the RIVER governance token steering parameters.

controls.label: River omni-CDP borrower-operations / OFT mint
controls.capDescription: Mint capped by per-branch overcollateralized CDP debt; cross-chain mint is authorized by LayerZero OFT messages confirming source-chain collateral lockup.
controls.evidence: River docs and LayerZero integration coverage describe a Liquity-v1-style CDP whose collateral stays source-chain; OFT _lzSend/_lzReceive messages relay collateral state to authorize satUSD mint on the destination chain.

controls.label: RIVER governance / cross-chain OFT peer admin
controls.evidence: RIVER token holders govern protocol parameters; the OFT/peer and message-relay configuration is admin-controlled rather than the immutable admin-key-free Liquity-v1 baseline.

review.evidence: River/Satoshi Protocol documentation, the Satoshi-Protocol GitHub org, and LayerZero integration coverage describe a Liquity-v1-derived omni-CDP with cross-chain OFT mint authorization and RIVER-token governance; no on-chain owner/peer admin was independently confirmed.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the on-chain owner/admin of the OFT mint contracts and the cross-chain peer configuration on each deployment.
Confirm whether any core CDP contracts have renounced ownership versus retaining an upgrade/admin multisig.
